description: Dataset of the cut-slope failure in the A-7 highway (S Spain) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jorge P. Galve, Jose Luis Perez-Garcia (Universidad de Granada). The dataset contains various datasets and media related to the landslide analysis on the failure occurred in 11 March 2021 in the Km 354.3 of the A-7 Highway (S Spain). Each folder contains specific types of data collected and processed during different stages of the cut-slope assessment, including raw data, processed materials, and media documentation. Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
